name: Empowered Arcane Catalyst
body:
Aura Strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs; Price 16,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

This rod allows the wielder pay 2 points from one ability score of his choice to cast an arcane spell as though it were modified by the Empower Spell metamagic feat, if the wielder has the pact class feature may use this item’s effects on his invocation and mystic blast class features as though with the Empower Spell-Like Ability feat and he may use this item once per day without paying its cost. This rod can affect up to 8 total levels of spells or spell-like abilities in a single day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Empower Spell; Cost 8,000 gp
